facts.fact: The Ministry of Public Service says civil servants' pay is delivered through bank accounts, ten years after payroll bancarisation was launched, with gaps remaining such as no bank branches in some areas and slow account opening.

COD.note: Biometric cards for payroll account management are only a roadmap intention; no national ID system stated.

Mobile banking for remote areas is only advocated; no mobile money service stated in service.
No tax or fee payment stated.
